Y matrix: rows are units (N=N0+N1), columns are time periods (T=T0+T1); treatment is simultaneous block: W[1:N0,] = 0, W[(N0+1):N,] = 0 for pre-treatment, W[(N0+1):N, (T0+1):T] = 1
Noise level estimated from first differences of pre-treatment control outcomes: sd(apply(Y[1:N0,1:T0], 1, diff))
Ridge tuning parameters: zeta.omega = eta.omega * noise.level; default eta.omega = (N1 * T1)^(1/4); eta.lambda = 1e-6

Main analysis files comprehensively read (450+685+300 lines). Appendix partially read (first 100 lines show robustness). Data preparation and key regression calls documented. Market model computations, event windows, DID periods, and synthetic control setup all traced. Vendored tool library skipped per policy.
Sampled 7 of 78 code files. Traced IV, OLS, reduced form, event study, and DID specifications across NYC and Cook County. Main identification: judge leniency as IV for eviction effects.
Staggered DID with state curriculum reforms. Main outcomes: evolution knowledge (NAEP), belief (GSS), career choice (ACS). OLS and csdid event studies with honestdid robustness.
